results.title: Members Club
results.overview: Wet Dreams, a middle aged male stripper group, take one last gig at a rural working mens club only to discover they are to become sacrifices in a plot to raise a murderous 16th century witch from the dead.

results.title: Coupe
results.overview: A nepotism baby meets her father for dinner at a restaurant and finds out that he’s going to cut her off if she doesn’t relinquish the family name. The ensuing argument forces her to face some harsh truths about family and how much she’d be willing to give up to keep it.

results.title: My Happiness
results.overview: An old man repairs a chair with great care. However, his goal may differ from that of other people.

results.title: Long Gone Heroes
results.overview: Gunner, a special forces soldier who has witnessed the darkest side of country and combat, is forced back into the field of battle to save his niece, who is being held in South America. As the fight intensifies, Gunner and his team discover that her disappearance is part of a corrupt private operation that hits way too close to home.

results.title: All Good
results.overview: Behind the facade of the phrase "All good" there may be a story that is not being told.

results.title: The Price of Nonna's Inheritance
results.overview: When a grandmother falls for a cheeky suitor with dubious intentions, her family devises a secret plan to protect her life — and their inheritance.

results.title: Beverly
results.overview: Carter and Sterling, two young lifelong best friends, are forced to face their differences when Sterling heads off to bootcamp, leaving Carter behind to watch over Sterling's little sister Beverly.

results.title: Sauna Day
results.overview: Sauna Day invites you into the world of Southern Estonian men who go to the dark-intimate space of a smoke sauna after a hard day's work. Beneath their tough exteriors lies a desire for connection, veiled in secrecy.

results.title: Birdeater
results.overview: A bride-to-be is invited to her own fiancé's bachelor party, but when uncomfortable details about their relationship are exposed, the night takes a feral turn.

results.title: Held Hostage in My House
results.overview: A single mother becomes trapped inside her own vacation rental and must piece together clues from the various guests who have stayed there in order to figure out who assaulted her and hopefully survive.

results.title: Benji
results.overview: Take a peek into the unsettling world of “Benji,” where every moment teeters on the edge of suspense. Fresh off the heels of a young couple’s arrival at Ms. O’Donnell’s enigmatic house, we delve into their gripping journey as they seek to uncover Benji’s long-lost archaeological find. With tension mounting and secrets lurking around every corner, their quest promises to unravel more than just buried relics.

results.title: graphic and the knapsack
results.overview: A futuristic VR film that explores the boundaries of memory and reality. In a world marked by catastrophic floods and heatwaves, the elderly Temp is confronted with traces of her past. As she engages in a table conversation with the mysterious Fabe, she embarks on an unpredictable journey through forgotten moments and enigmatic sounds. This leads us into the twists and turns of her mind, culminating in a musical duet between two generations.

results.title: Polydroso
results.overview: Sophia, the daughter, is returning to the Athenian suburb of Polydroso to take care of Sophia, the mother. Back in her neighbourhood, she will confront the reasons that made her leave in the first place. Polydroso is a mystical isolated suburb and both Sophias spend their time daydreaming about ghosts of the past. A film about tender people in a non-tender world.

results.title: The Night They Came Home
results.overview: The combined force of local lawmen and Indian police aim to take down the the Rufus Buck Gang, a cold-heated band of fugitives with vengeance on their minds.

results.title: Junior Associate
results.overview: An accidental suitcase swap at the airport baggage claim puts a corporate underling's career—and life—in jeopardy.

results.title: Restless Waters, Shivering Lights
results.overview: Lidia and her father, Pablo, return to the family lighthouse after her mother’s death. Pablo, aware of Lidia's fragile emotional balance, worries for a possible relapse after her suicide attempt. Lidia, annoyed by her father's lack of trust, will discover that something’s not right at the Lighthouse, and that danger awaits for them if they do not find out the truth.

results.title: Weave
results.overview: UK short film about how traditional hairstyles among Black British people weaves its way through the lives of all generations and genders.

results.title: Kereta
results.overview: Meeting in an unexpected place with an unexpected situation but ultimately being able to accept each other, Maudy who wants to make peace with herself and Hansi who always wants to be grateful.

results.title: Rob Peace
results.overview: An underprivileged, gifted young black man from Newark reaches Yale University, only for shadows and injustices from his past to threaten his future.
